backtest._comment_htf_candles_per_range: M15 bars per completed HTF window (HTFBuilder). 4 = 1H, 16 = 4H. The ONLY effect is how often current_htf_id flips, which ResetLogic.should_reset compares to active_range.htf_candle_id (DISPLACEMENT/SWEEP/RANGE/SHADOW_PENDING reset; EXPANSION/RETEST exempt). Independent of crt_engine.pending_displacement_ttl_candles, retrace_reset_pct, sessions, and TP. Changing this key does not change those rules.
backtest._comment_warmup_candles: T-16 (2026-07-23): raised 30 -> 78 to match the feature pipeline's CANONICAL warmup, which FeaturePipeline.finalize() drops. 78 is DERIVED, not chosen: feature_pipeline.ma_periods[0](20) + 1 (ma_slope diff) + trend_strength_window(10) - 1 + zscore_window(50) - 1, resolved by features.feature_pipeline.required_warmup_rows(). At 30 the replay loop ran candles 30..77 through the CRT state machine with NO feature row behind them, and a trade opened there silently received a zero vector. BacktestRunner now refuses to start when this value is below the derived one, so changing any of those three feature_pipeline windows without raising this key FAILS LOUDLY instead of reopening the gap.
backtest._comment_engine_gate_enabled: F-058 resolution (2026-07-23). The 4-engine fusion gate (CRT/Gaussian/ZoneGate/RR -> Fusion -> DecisionEngine veto) inside EngineRunner.run(). Previously declared NOWHERE and read only as os.getenv('BACKTEST_ENGINE_GATE', '1'), so documented behavior depended on an UNTRACKED .env: F-037/active_models.yaml describe it as OFF while the code default is ON, and any scrubbed/CI environment silently produced a different ledger. Declared here as the authority; the env var remains an explicit override and now logs at WARNING when it disagrees. Declaring ON is an EPOCH CHANGE -- the gate-OFF research corpus (F-019...F-036) stays valid for its own epoch and is not retro-invalidated.
backtest._comment_bypass_zone_invalid: F-058-class fix (2026-07-29, target-strategy-architecture.md sec13 item2). Backtest-mode bypass for the zone_gate_invalid EngineRunner rejection: that rule is production-only (requires a populated zone_registry.json; backtest sees <=5 zones, treated as "no zones"). Was os.getenv("BACKTEST_BYPASS_ZONE_INVALID", "1"), declared in no config -- same undeclared-env-truth class as F-058's engine_gate_enabled. Declared here as the authority (true = current behavior, byte-identical); the env var remains an explicit override and logs at WARNING when it disagrees.

feature_pipeline._comment_session_windows: FM-052 v4.0 (2026-07-22, SCHEMA-V4-VECTOR-MIGRATION). REPLACES session_asia_end_hour/session_london_end_hour, which defined a 3-value hour PARTITION (0 if h<8 else 1 if h<16 else 2). Those keys are REMOVED rather than reused: silently redefining a key's meaning is the config-illusion class F-056 closed. Half-open [start, end) UTC hours, matching the old `hour < end` convention. OVERLAP (=LONDON n NEWYORK) and CLOSED (=no window) are DERIVED and deliberately NOT configurable. These are the FEATURE's windows (real market sessions); the FILTER's narrow trading bands live in CRTConfig.session_windows and are a different concept - see src/features/session_classifier.py.
feature_pipeline._comment_swing: PHASE B (2026-07-19) TUNABLE STRUCTURAL, HIGHEST BLAST RADIUS. swing_window sets BOTH the pivot half-window (rolling width 2k+1) AND the FC1-A causal publication delay (available_at = t+k) -- it determines WHEN a feature becomes knowable, not just how it is sized. It defines lookback on FM-045/046, and 6 governance/certification scripts record it as a provenance fact. Changing it invalidates every artifact certified against the old value and requires re-certification, not just a re-run.
feature_pipeline._comment_normalization_basis: FM-030/031 IDENTITY SELECTOR (2026-07-22, program FM-030-031-DIMENSIONAL-MIX-MIGRATION). Not a period -- it chooses WHICH registered identity ema_spread/momentum_score emit. 'atr_relative' = FM-022/FM-023, numerator / atr; because atr is close-relative (atr_14_raw/close) and the numerator is absolute price, the emitted value scales with price level (legacy == corrected * close). This is the DEFAULT and is byte-identical to the pre-2026-07-22 pipeline -- the XAUUSD freeze-pin vector SHA is its parity proof. 'atr_absolute' = FM-030/FM-031, numerator / (atr * close), scale-invariant. F-061 measured the legacy arm's decision-surface cost on crypto (detect_regime ~constant 'trend', breakout score pinned at 1.0, tanh(momentum) saturated); the corrected arm is measured via configs/production/v2_multi_dimfix_shadow_2026_07.json and carries NO production authority (CLAUDE.md 6.5).
feature_pipeline._comment_session_timestamp_basis: F-066 (2026-08-01, blind-label investigation). Selects which clock hour_of_day/session (FM-052) derive from. 'broker_local' = the DEFAULT, byte-identical to every pipeline run before this key existed: uses the raw timestamp column as-is. For this MT5-sourced corpus that raw timestamp is actually broker-server time (EET/EEST, tracking America/New_York DST), NOT UTC, despite session_windows_utc's name -- measured 53.36 pct of XAUUSD bars carry the wrong session label under this basis (two independent cross-instrument tests: BTCUSDT cross-correlation, NFP-release alignment; see docs/research/preregistration-blind-label-descriptive-fidelity.md). 'utc_corrected' = derives from features/broker_clock.py's true-UTC conversion, making session/hour_of_day match what session_windows_utc already claims. This key stays 'broker_local' here; flipping the ACTIVE config to 'utc_corrected' is a separate, explicitly-gated decision (feature-vector SHA changes on ~53 pct of bars, freeze-pin re-certification required) -- NOT made by this config edit.

strict_fetch._doc: Zero-tolerance override (passed as cfg_override to validate_dataset by scripts/data/fetch_and_verify_mt5.py). Any TRADABLE missing bar (session-aware: weekends/rollover/holidays excluded) hard-stops the freshly-fetched file. Genuine mid-session holes are corruption and abort; legitimate closures are non-tradable and pass. tradability_mode=autoderive LEARNS each provider's real session from the data's modal weekly presence (so any broker's no-Sunday/no-break/shifted-open calendar self-calibrates); holidays still need the reviewed session_calendar.holidays list.

session_calendar._holidays_doc: Reviewed market-closure dates (UTC) surfaced by the strict autoderive gate on IC-Markets FX+metals data 2026-06-26. Union of FX (Christmas/New Year) + XAUUSD US-market calendar (Memorial/Juneteenth/Jul4/Labor/Thanksgiving/MLK/Presidents/Good-Friday/Christmas-Eve). Applied to ALL symbols (over-marking a date a symbol DID trade is harmless: present bars on a holiday are extra, never 'missing'). DELIBERATELY EXCLUDES intraday micro-gaps (e.g. 2026-03-25, 2026-04-01, 2025-06-02, 2025-07-30) which are genuine 5-7 bar feed holes, NOT closures, and must keep hard-stopping per the zero-tolerance rule.
session_calendar._known_gaps_doc: Reviewed, timestamp-RANGE accept-list for genuine intraday broker feed outages (a few bars) that are NOT full-day closures — so the good bars that day are kept (unlike whole-day holidays). Each entry: {symbol?(optional; omit=all), from, to (half-open UTC ISO), reason}. A bar inside any applicable range is treated as non-tradable (accepted). EMPTY DEFAULT = byte-parity; entries are added ONLY by reviewed decision after the strict gate surfaces a hole confirmed to be a broker outage (not corruption). Populated 2026-07-02 from the IC-Markets bulk-fetch review: broker-wide multi-symbol windows are global; single-symbol holes are scoped; XAUUSD 2026-05-25/06-19 are US-holiday early-closes (gold) not yet in the holidays list.
